comment: An ajax update whose session has EXPIRED (the session ID no longer resolves) is marked by the server - status 403 and the x-session-expired header, whatever the application's handleSessionRestorationErrorInContext answered - so the client knows for certain rather than guessing from the response's shape. Points a container's data-updateUrl at component-action and ajax-handler URLs naming a session that doesn't exist, fires an update, and asserts the error detail says sessionExpired, the banner shows the expired-session message with a Continue button, and the container is untouched.

steps.name: detail
steps.expression: JSON.stringify({status: window.__err && window.__err.status, sessionExpired: window.__err && window.__err.sessionExpired, document: !!(window.__err && window.__err.document)})

steps.name: the server marked the session as expired (403, not a guess)
banner says the session has expired
nothing was morphed into the container

steps.text: The same through AjaxSlim's own ajax request handler.

steps.name: detailAjax
steps.expression: JSON.stringify({status: window.__err && window.__err.status, sessionExpired: window.__err && window.__err.sessionExpired})

steps.name: the ajax handler's expired session is marked too
